answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital, turning the network into a steep canyon of financial risk for attackers. To gain influence, one must bridge assets across a digital ledge where the cost of verification is as hard as cracking a walnut shell. An adversary attempting to forge multiple identities must acquire a proportional stake of the total network value, ensuring that the economic cost of identity multiplication exceeds any potential gain from collusion.
